title: Correct Recent form expectations for optional read-audit support
platforms: Platform-independent test; Windows GNU builds executed via Wine
changes: Correct the existing shared-control form test: Recent with reads off must validate in both builds; reads on must preserve the production refusal without rom-data-read-audit and succeed with the feature. Check the returned setting and capability error instead of treating every default form as unconditionally supported.
Include the actual validation error when other default control-form assertions fail. Production defaults, feature guard, parser and report behavior are unchanged.
validation: Default and rom-data-read-audit Windows GNU release test builds passed without compiler diagnostics. Ran only every_form_has_bounded_unique_fields_and_shared_control_validation on Wine for each configuration:1 passed in each; all other tests left unrun.

The first audit build failed against a stale gba-core rlib Cargo incorrectly reported fresh; saved dependency metadata lacked current debug-memory/raw-transfer modules. A scoped Windows release gba-core cache clean and audit-only rebuild resolved it; the accepted default run was not repeated and diagnostics were retained.
Confirmed no production Rust files changed and the user-generated ROM coverage JSON/HTML hashes remained unchanged.
limitations: The full Linux Docker suite/package export and native Windows runtime were not rerun. This closes the reported feature-dependent test assertion; existing game/ROM acceptance and performance remain outside the check.
